notes.title: New Ganymede: Discovery Tour
notes.content:
New Ganymede is an upcoming free-to-play open world indie sci-fi fantasy MMOARPG extravaganza where you can run, glide, shoot, slash, dash, roll and generally panic your way through co-op PVE with friends in a beautiful narrative driven world developed by an Australia-based team.

New Ganymede: Discovery Tour!
Join us for an unforgettable streaming event as we unveil our highly anticipated game to the world! 

Get ready for an exciting event filled with surprises, exclusive gameplay, and an in-depth look at the masterminds behind the creation. 

What’s the lineup for New Ganymede Discovery Tour?

 ➡️ Extended devlog + 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗮𝗹 
 ➡️ Meet the crew + 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
Tune-in for guaranteed never-seen-before content!

Follow us to join our development journey: learn about the process and production of indie games, behind the scenes and get excited about exclusive footage from our upcoming alpha demo.


 Follow us on Twitter / TikTok / Instagram
 Join our Discord
 Visit our Website

Embark on an exclusive Discovery Tour - see you soon!
